en: What is wrong with you today?
u.src: “你今天怎么啦？
看起来情绪有些低落呢……”

en: The day after the fire broke out, I had a cigarette in my mouth and was talking with the student Lapp, who was sitting in a chair in my living room.
u.src: 火灾发生后的第二天，我嘴里叼着烟卷，和坐在我家客厅的椅子上的学生拉卟交谈。

en: Lapp crossed his right leg over his left, lowered his head, and stared blankly at the floor, so that even that sore, rotten mouth of his was almost out of sight.
u.src: 拉卟把右腿跷到左腿上，低垂着头看着地板发呆，那的烂嘴都快看不见了。

en: Mr. Rapp, I am talking to you. What is the matter with you?
u.src: “拉卟君，我和你说话呢，你怎么啦？”

en: It was nothing, just a dull little thing...
u.src: “没什么，是一件没意思的小事儿……”

en: Rapp raised his eyelids and glanced at me, then said in a desolate nasal voice,
u.src: 拉卟抬起眼睑看了看我，用凄凉的鼻音说道，

en: Today, while I was looking at the scenery outside the window, I casually said, 'Look, the butterwort is blooming.'
u.src: “我今天看窗外风景的时候，随口中说了句：‘看啊，捕虫堇开花啦。’

en: When my younger sister heard that, her face darkened and she flew into a rage: 'So I am the butterwort, am I?'
u.src: 我妹妹听了脸色低沉大发脾气：‘我就是捕虫堇呗。’

en: My mother has always favored my younger sister most, so she joined in and scolded me too."
u.src: 我妈一直最偏向我妹妹，也跟着斥责我了。”

en: Why did your remark, 'The butterwort is blooming,' make your sister unhappy?
u.src: “你的那句‘捕虫堇开花啦’，为什么会让你妹妹不快了呢？”

en: Hmm, maybe she took those words to mean catching a male kappa.
u.src: “唔，也许她把这句话当成‘捉雄河童’的意思了。

en: At the time, my aunt, who had always been on bad terms with my mother, also butted in, and the quarrel grew worse and worse.
u.src: 当时，一向和我妈关系紧张的婶婶也来插一脚，吵得越来越凶。

en: On top of that, my father, who was always drinking himself senseless, heard us arguing and started hitting whoever was there without asking why.
u.src: 而且我常年喝得不省人事的爹，听到我们在争执，就不辨缘由看人就打。

en: Just when everything had fallen into chaos, my younger brother took advantage of it to steal my mother's wallet and ran off to see a movie or something.
u.src: 正闹得乱套的时候，我弟弟趁乱偷了妈妈的钱包，跑去看电影什么的了。
我……我真是……”

en: Rap covered his face with both hands and began to cry silently.
u.src: 拉卟两只手捂住脸，默默地哭起来。

en: I undoubtedly felt great sympathy for him, and at the same time remembered the poet Tokku's contempt for the kappa family system.
u.src: 我无疑非常同情他，同时想起了诗人托喀对河童家族制度的鄙夷态度。

en: I gently patted Rap on the shoulder and did my best to comfort him:
u.src: 我轻轻拍了拍拉卟的肩膀，尽力给他安慰：

en: "This is nothing so serious. Try to keep your spirits up."
u.src: “这不是什么大不了的事儿，加油吧。”

en: But... if only my mouth had not rotted...
u.src: “但是……如果我的嘴没有烂就好了……”

en: You just have to try to take it a little easier.
u.src: “你只能想开一点。

en: Come on, let's go over to Tok's house together and have some fun.
u.src: 走吧，咱们一起到托喀家去玩吧。”

en: Tok-kun has always despised me because I cannot bravely abandon my family the way he did.
u.src: “托喀君一向鄙视我，因为我无法跟他一样勇敢地抛弃家族。”

en: Then let's go to Kurabaka's house for a visit.
u.src: “那么咱们就到库拉巴喀家去玩吧。”

ja: ともかくまずラップを
en: After that concert, I also became friends with Kurabakka, so in any case I first took Rapp to this great musician's house.
u.src: 那次音乐会之后，我和库拉巴喀也成了朋友，总而言之先把拉卟带到这位大音乐家的家里去。

en: Compared with Tok, Kurabakka lived in greater comfort and wealth.
u.src: 和托喀相比，库拉巴喀生活的更加阔绰富裕。

ja: ゲエルほどだったとは
en: Even so, I would not say he lived like the capitalist Gael.
u.src: 不过也不说他生活得像资本家嘎尔一样。

en: His house was filled with all kinds of antiques,
u.src: 他的家里摆满了各种各样的古董——

en: things such as Tanagra figurines and Persian pottery, as well as a Turkish-style couch,
u.src: 诸如塔那格拉偶人和波斯陶器之类的，还有土耳其式躺椅，

en: and Kurabakka would often play with the children beneath his own portrait.
u.src: 库拉巴喀时常在自己的画像下面和孩子们一起玩耍。

en: But today, for some reason, he sat there with his arms folded, his face full of indignation,
u.src: 可今天不知为何，他双手交叉抱着，满脸愤慨的坐在那儿，

en: with scraps of torn paper scattered all around his feet.
u.src: 脚底下布满了碎纸片。

en: Originally, Rapp often went with the poet Tok to visit Kurabakka,
u.src: 原本拉卟常常和诗人托喀一道儿去拜访库拉巴喀的，

en: but seeing him like this at that moment must have greatly surprised him,
u.src: 但此时这幅样子可能让他很是惊讶，

en: and today he merely gave Kurabakka a respectful bow,
u.src: 今天他只是恭敬的对着库拉巴喀鞠个一躬，

en: then quietly sat down in a corner of the room.
u.src: 就悄悄地坐到房间的角落里了。

en: Without even stopping to say hello, I asked the great musician directly, "Has something happened to you, Kurabakka?"
u.src: 我顾不上打招呼，就直接问这位大音乐家：“你是发生什么事了吗，库拉巴喀君？”
“我没事！
评论家那种蠢货！

en: They think my lyric poems are far inferior to Tok's!
u.src: 认为我的抒情诗和托喀相比差远啦！”
“但是你是一位音乐家呀……”

en: If it were only that, I could still bear it.
u.src: “要是单单这样还可以忍。

en: He even remarked that compared with Rock, I hardly counted as a musician at all!
u.src: 他还评论，和啰喀相比，我连音乐家都算不上啦！”

en: Roka was a musician often mentioned in the same breath as Kurabaka.
u.src: 啰喀是个经常被拿来跟库拉巴喀相提并论的音乐家。

en: But he was not a member of the Superman Club, and I had never spoken with him.
u.src: 不过他不是超人俱乐部的会员，我从未跟他讲过话。

en: However, I had seen many photographs of him: his mouth jutted out, and his appearance was unlike that of ordinary people.
u.src: 不过我看到过很多他的照片：嘴巴翘起来，相貌异于常人。

en: Of course, Rock is also a genius.
u.src: “当然，啰喀也是个天才。

en: But his music does not have the kind of modern passion that overflows from the power of your music.
u.src: 但是他的音乐没有你的音乐力洋溢出的那种近代的热情。”
“你真的这么认为吗？”
“毫无疑问！”

en: Then, all at once, Kurabaka stood up and violently hurled the Tanagra doll down onto the floor.
u.src: 于是，突然库拉巴喀站了起来，狠狠的把塔那格拉偶人摔倒了地上。

en: Rapp must have been terribly frightened; he cried out something and lifted his leg to run away.
u.src: 拉卟可能非常害怕，不知喊了声什么，抬起腿想跑。

en: Kurabaka made a gesture to Rapp and me that meant, Do not be afraid,
u.src: 库拉巴喀向拉卟和我做了个 “别害怕”的手势，

en: and said with perfect composure, That is because your ears, like those of ordinary people, are only ornaments.
u.src: 镇静自若地说道：“这是因为你也跟俗人一样耳朵是个摆设。

en: What I am afraid of is Loka...
u.src: 我害怕啰喀……”
“你吗？
别假装谦虚吧。”

ja: ぶっているというのだ？
en: Who is pretending to be modest?
u.src: “谁假装谦虚了？

en: Besides, if I were going to pretend to be modest, I would rather do it before the critics than in front of you.
u.src: 而且，与其在你们面前装谦虚，我倒更宁愿到评论家面前去装呢。

en: I, Kurabaka, am a true genius.
u.src: 我——库拉巴喀是真正的天才。

ja: がっているわけではない。」
en: I am not afraid of Paroka.
u.src: 我并不是害怕怕啰喀。”

en: Then what are you afraid of?
u.src: “那你害怕的是什么？”

en: Afraid of that unknown thing -- in short, afraid of the star that controls Roka.
u.src: “怕那个不知道是什么的东西——简言之，怕操纵啰喀的星星。”
“我可没听懂。”

en: So this should make it clear: Luoka is not influenced by me.
u.src: “这么说就懂了吧：啰喀受不到我的影响。

en: But without realizing it, I was influenced by him.
u.src: 可我却不知不觉的被他影响了。”

en: That is probably because you are too sensitive...
u.src: “那是因为你过于敏感性的缘故吧……”

en: Listen, this is not a question of sensitivity at all.
u.src: “听着，根本不是敏感性的问题。

en: Rokku can always be content with his own work.
u.src: 啰喀总是能安于自己的工作。

en: But I am always restless and uneasy.
u.src: 但是我却总是焦躁不安。

en: From Rokku's point of view, it may be only one step away,
u.src: 从啰喀的眼里看，可能只是一步之遥，

en: but to my eyes, it is ten miles apart.
u.src: 但是在我眼里看却差之十里呢。”
“但是您弹奏的《英雄曲》……”

en: Kurabaka's narrow eyes narrowed even more, and he glared fiercely at Rappu and said:
u.src: 库拉巴喀的眯缝眼眯得更小了，他凶神恶煞般瞪着拉卟说：

en: Stop talking. What do you know?
u.src: “不要再说啦。你知道什么？

en: I understand Roka better than those fawning lackeys who bow and scrape before him.
u.src: 我对啰喀的了解胜于那些对他点头哈腰的狗奴才。”
“别激动。”

en: Who would want to get excited...
u.src: “谁想要激动呢……

en: I often cannot help thinking that somewhere in the dark, someone must have made Roka appear before my eyes just to toy with me.
u.src: 我常常不由的想：冥冥之中好像有谁为了玩弄我，才让啰喀出现在我眼前。

en: Philosopher Mag may spend all day reading those old books under a colored glass lantern, but he actually understands this sort of thing quite well.
u.src: 别看哲学家马咯成天在彩色玻璃灯笼下读那些古书，但他对这种事却相当了解呢。”
“为什么啊？”

en: Take a look at this book, Words of a Fool, which Maguro wrote recently...
u.src: “马咯最近写的傻子的话》这本书，你看看吧……”

en: Rather than handing it to me, Kurabaka practically threw me a book.
u.src: 与其说库拉巴喀递给我，毋宁说是丢给我一本书。

en: Then he folded his arms and said roughly, "Well, that will be all for today."
u.src: 接着他抱着胳膊粗鲁地说：“那么今天就到这里吧。”

en: I decided to go out into town with the listless Lapp.
u.src: 我决定和无精打采的拉卟一起去逛街。

en: On both sides of the busy avenue, under the shade of rows of beech trees, all kinds of shops were still lined up in orderly fashion.
u.src: 络绎不绝的大街两侧，成行的山毛榉树的树荫下依旧是井井有条排列的 各种各样的商店。
我们静静的散步。

en: At that moment, the long-haired poet Tokku came walking toward us.
u.src: 这个时候，留着长发的诗人托喀走了过来。

en: As soon as Tokk caught sight of us, he took a handkerchief from his belly pouch and wiped his forehead again and again,
u.src: 托喀一瞥见我们，就从肚袋里拿出手绢，反反复复地擦额头，

ja: いしていませんでした。
en: he said, "Well, it has been a very long time since we last met."
u.src: 说：“哎呀，很长时间不见了。

en: I plan to go see Kurabakka today, and I also haven't seen him for many days..."
u.src: 今天我计划去找库拉巴喀，我也已经很多天没见到他啦……”

ja: しにゲンへ、クラバカは
en: I was worried that the two artists might start quarreling, so I tactfully mentioned to Gen that Kurabaka was not in a very good mood today.
u.src: 我担心这两位艺术家会吵起来，就婉转地向跟提了提库拉巴喀今天情绪不太好。
“是这样吗？
那就算了。
库拉巴喀神经衰弱……

en: For the past two or three weeks, I have hardly been able to sleep either, and I feel terribly troubled.
u.src: 这两三个星期，我也总失眠，心很烦呢。”

en: Why don't you come for a walk with us?
u.src: “你和我们一道散散步吧？”

en: No, let's call it a day.
u.src: “不了，今天就算啦。
哎呀！”

en: After Toka finished speaking, he seized my arm fiercely, with cold sweat pouring down.
u.src: 托喀说完，狠狠的抓住我的胳膊，冷汗直流。
“你怎么了？”
“怎么了？”

en: I felt as if a green monkey's head were sticking out of that car window.
u.src: “我感觉到那辆汽车窗口伸出来一只绿色的猴子脑袋。”

en: I was somewhat worried about his condition, so I urged him to go and have Doctor Chack examine him.
u.src: 我有些点担心他的状况，就劝他去请医生查喀那检查一下。

en: But no matter how we tried to persuade him, Tok refused to go, and he looked at the two of us suspiciously and said this strange thing: "
u.src: 可是无论怎么劝说，托喀也不愿意去，而且还怀疑的看着我们俩，说出这种奇怪的话：“

en: I am absolutely not an anarchist.
u.src: 我绝对不是无政府主义者。

en: Please be absolutely sure to remember that. -- Well then, goodbye.
u.src: 这一点请千万记住。——那么，再见吧。

ja: にチャックのところへ
en: I will absolutely not go to Chack!"
u.src: 我绝对不会去找查喀！”

en: We stood there blankly, watching Tokk walk away.
u.src: 我们呆呆的站在那里，目送着托喀的走远。

en: We - no, the student Rapp was already no longer at my side,
u.src: 我们——不，学生拉卟早就不在我身侧了，

en: Before I knew it, he had run into the middle of the road, spread his legs, bent over, and was watching the endless stream of cars and kappa from between his legs.
u.src: 不知何时，他已跑到马路中央，叉开腿，弯身从胯下观看络绎不绝的汽车和河童。

en: I thought this kappa had gone mad too, so I quickly pulled him aside:
"What are you joking about? What are you making such a fuss for?"
u.src: 我以为这个河童也疯了，赶紧把他拽到一边：“开什么玩笑呀，你闹什么？”

en: Rappu rubbed his eyes and said with perfect calm, "Well, I was so depressed,
u.src: 拉卟揉了揉眼睛，无比冷静的说：“唔，我太郁闷了，

en: so I wanted to turn upside down and see what this world looked like.
u.src: 因此想倒转过来看看这个世界是什么样子。

en: But there really was no difference at all."
u.src: 可是并没什么差别啊。”
